race.comment: TRULY LOYAL (4) got back on debut but ran good splits when beaten as a $1.85 favourite on debut. He's trialled well coming in again this time and Pike rides from a better draw. The form out of his debut run worked out well and he can make a statement on his return. BIFF BAM BOOM (12) has shown enough at the trials to suggest he can run a bold race here. Pike was on board for his latest trial and opts to ride TRULY LOYAL, though his latest outing was very impressive. Can show what he's capable of on debut. SWEET ISSY (7) was solid first-up from well back and turned in a solid figure there. Should be better for that effort and won't be far away. PLAYA DEL SOL (6) won a trial coming into this but couldn't go with them first-up when fading out of contention. Should be better for that effort and a forward showing is on the cards. CALL ME INVINCIBLE (1) won't be far away after a good effort here last week.
